test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 17 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Refer to the following letter, number and symbol series and answer the question.

(Left) V 2 5 U @ ρ W ¥ # 2 Ω A R Q 1 @ F B 4 6 # H J % Z E (Right)

If all the consonants are dropped from the series, what will be the position of ‘Ω' from the left?
solution:
**Given Series:**

(Left) V 2 5 U @ ρ W ¥ # 2 Ω A R Q 1 @ F B 4 6 # H J % Z E (Right)

We know,

Consonants → All alphabets except Vowels (A, E, I, O, U)

After dropping consonants from the given series, the series we get is as follows,

2 5 U @ ρ ¥ # 2 Ω A 1 @ 4
